snippet.title: TASU Bowl // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► hhttps://store.steampowered.com/app/3607840/TASU_Bowl

TASU Bowl is a casual deck-building game that mixes bowling with roguelike elements. Use balls, pins, score frames, and items—each with unique effects—to take control of the game. It’s not just about strikes and spares—enjoy a whole new kind of bowling experience!

Developed by 
KAYAC Inc.
